name: sportsdataverse-js
description: Retrieves sports data from a popular sports website as well as from the NCAA website, with support for NBA, WNBA, NFL, NHL, College Football and mens and womens college basketball,

paragraphs: sportsdataverse is the SportsDataverse's Node.js / TypeScript client for sports data: the cross-league ESPN API, the leagues' own live APIs, a set of cross-sport providers, and the published SportsDataverse / nflverse release datasets — with one parser layer, one error vocabulary and TypeScript types for every call.
namespace (MLB Stats, Statcast, NHL ×4, NFL.com, stats.nba.com, …) and 13 provider families on their own (HockeyTech, The Odds API, CBS, Fox, Yahoo, 247Sports, On3, …).

It is the Node.js sister to sportsdataverse-py and the SportsDataverse R packages (hoopR, wehoop, cfbfastR, fastRhockey, …). The public names are sportsdataverse-py's, so a function has the same name in Python and JavaScript.
features: 126 ESPN endpoints on 30 leagues, identical on every league.
1060 flat-API wrappers across 27 families — 14 league families on their league
323 dataset loaders (load) that read the release parquet directly.

requirements.text: Two optional peers unlock specific families: impit (browser TLS impersonation — stats.nba.com, stats.wnba.com, 247Sports, KenPom) and playwright (the NFL Pro email / password login).
